report.title: SinterCast Interim Report Q3 2026

results.text: Recurring revenue accounted for 91.6% (87.1%) of total revenue. · Operating Result: SEK 15.4 million (SEK 5.6 million), an increase of 175%, driven by the 19% recovery in series production and lower operating expenses.

Recurring revenue accounted for 93.6% (92.9%) of the revenue. · Operating Result: SEK 29.1 million (SEK 27.0 million), an increase of 8%, supported by higher recurring revenue and lower operating expenses, despite prior-year net operating exchange gains of SEK 3.5 million.

outlook.text: The installation pipeline remains strong, with opportunities for new installations towards year-end, supporting our expectation that average annual installation revenues during 2026–2027 could exceed the historical level of approximately SEK 8 million.

report.title: Kempower Corporation Interim report 2026 1 January-30 September 2026: Outperforming a sharply weaker market, resetting costs for 2027

results.text: Operative EBIT decreased to EUR -1.7 million (EUR 0.2 million), -2.6% of revenue (0.2%).
As investment in public charging slowed sharply, our order intake decreased by 19% and revenue by 10%.
Against this backdrop, our revenue grew 12% in January-September.
In Q3, while new public DC fast charging installations in Europe declined 22%, our European revenue declined 5%, and in Europe outside the Nordics it grew 10%.
In the Nordics, revenue decreased 30% as existing customers moderated investments.
Aftermarket revenue grew 83% in Q3 and 60% in January-September, and represented 8% of Q3 revenue, double the share of a year ago.

outlook.text: The new outlook is as follows: 2026 revenue is expected to grow approximately 5% compared to year 2025, assuming no major impact from foreign currency exchange rates (revenue 2025: EUR 251.3 million). 2026 operative EBIT is expected to be lower compared to year 2025 (operative EBIT 2025: EUR -12.4 million).
The updated financial targets are: Revenue growth: 15-25% CAGR over 2025–2030, in constant currency, range based on different market growth scenarios.
With an order backlog of EUR 128 million (9% higher than a year ago) and liquidity of EUR 91 million, we have the backlog and balance sheet to deliver.

report.title: Novo raises full-year outlook on continued GLP-1 momentum, with third-quarter adjusted operating profit increasing 27% at CER to DKK 31,720 million

results.text: Q3 2026 adjusted and reported sales increased by 4% at CER, driven by continued GLP-1 volume growth across the US and International operations, primarily in obesity.

Q3 2026 adjusted operating profit increased by 27% at CER, driven by GLP-1 sales growth and a favourable comparison base following DKK 9 billion of company-wide transformation costs recognised in Q3 2025.

Q3 2026 reported operating profit decreased by 9% at CER, reflecting DKK 8.7 billion of non-cash impairment charges in the quarter, related to ziltivekimab (DKK 4.6 billion) and right-sizing of manufacturing network (DKK 4.1 billion).
Reported sales in Q3 2026 increased by 6% measured in Danish kroner and by 4% at CER, driven by continued GLP-1 volume growth across geographies, particularly in obesity.
Reported sales in 9M 2026 increased by 11% measured in Danish kroner and by 13% at CER, driven by GLP-1.
Q3 2026 adjusted sales increased by 4% at CER to DKK 79,195 million, driven by GLP-1 volume growth in both operating units, partly offset by lower realised prices.

outlook.text: Adjusted sales growth for 2026 is now expected to be -2% to +2% at CER and adjusted operating profit growth is now expected to be -2% to +2% at CER.

results.text: Volume growth was driven by a combination of increased activity levels at customer sites and expansion of contracts with existing customers and contributed around 0.5%-point to organic growth.
September 2026 Group revenue in the first nine months of 2026 was DKK 67.5 billion, an increase of 8.3% compared with the same period last year.

Organic growth was 7.7%, acquisitions and divestments, net were positive by 1.4%, whereas currency effects were negative with 1.4% and the net impact from hyperinflation restatement in Türkiye (IAS 29) was positive with 0.6%.

Organic growth was 7.7% in the first nine months of 2026 (2025: 4.3%), driven by price increases, projects and above -base work, including the DTAG one-off revenue adjustment, and the annualisation of 2025 contract wins and volume growth.
This had a positive effect on organic growth of around 4 %-points of which around half related to Türkiye.

outlook.text: We reaffirm our 2026 outlook as updated on 19 May 2026 of organic growth above 6%, operating margin around 5.25% and free cash flow above DKK 3.1bn.

However, adjusted for DKK 0.2 billion in prepayments for receiv ables paid in 2025 before due date in 2026 and the payment by DTAG of previously withheld amounts, the reported free cash flow is expected to be above DKK 3.1 billion for 2026.

Expected revenue impact from acquisitions, divestments and foreign exchange rates in 2026 Acquisitions and divestments completed by 31 October 2026 (including in 2025) are expected to have a positive impact on revenue growth in 2026 of 1.5%-point.

Based on the current exchange rates, a negative impact on revenue growth of around 1%-point1 is expected in 2026 from the development of foreign exchange rates, excluding any effects of hyperinflation (IAS 29).

report.title: BioMar Group Q3 2026 Report - Strong volume growth and exceptional earnings

results.text: Despite higher fixed costs, EBIT for the first nine months of the year amounted to DKK 977m, compared with DKK 785m in the corresponding period last year.
Profit & loss Revenue increased by 19% to DKK 5,807m in Q3 2026 from DKK 4,898m in Q3 2025, driven by higher volumes and increasing raw material prices, particularly marine fish oil and fish meal.

Revenue for the first nine months of 2026 increased by 7% to DKK 13,172m from DKK 12,270m year to date in Q3 2025, primarily reflecting higher volumes, raw material prices and product and customer mix.
Other costs and other operating income and expenses increased year on year in Q3 2026 from DKK 352m to DKK 432m.
For the first nine months of 2026, other costs and other operating income and expenses increased year on year from DKK 929m to DKK 1,121m, reflecting the same matters as above.
EBIT for Q3 2026 amounted to DKK 618m, compared with DKK 411m in Q3 2025, supported by higher feed volumes and significantly improved earnings in the Salmon segment especially.

outlook.text: Supported by the volume outlook, higher raw material prices and current exchange rates, BioMar raises its 2026 revenue guidance to DKK 17.8-18.6 billion range from previously DKK 17.0-18.0 billion.

Based on strong earnings momentum in the first nine months of 2026, but a lower volume guidance for 2026, increasing prices on ingredients, and uncertainties particularly related to Ecuador, BioMar is upgrading its EBIT guidance to DKK 1,290-1,360 million range from previously DKK 1,200-1,300 million.

report.title: Kesko interim report 1.1.-30.9.2026: Kesko's profit improved significantly - technical trade continues as the driver

results.text: Our net sales totalled €3,394 million, representing an increase of 4.7% in comparable terms.
In the grocery trade division, net sales increased by 2.7% and totalled €1,690 million.
K Group’s grocery sales grew by 1.8%, while the total grocery market in Finland grew by approximately 0.6%.
Kespro’s net sales decreased by 1.0% as the foodservice market remained challenging, but Kespro managed to gain market share.
In the building and technical trade division, net sales grew in all operating countries, totalling €1,328 million.
The marked improvement in profit was attributable in particular to technical trade, where net sales grew by 11.3%, with sales growth being the strongest in Finland, Norway and Poland.

outlook.text: Kesko estimates that its 2026 comparable operating profit will amount to €690–‍730 million.
Our order book for new cars was up by nearly 70% year-on-year and by some 65% since the start of the year.
We are updating our profit guidance, and now estimate that Kesko’s comparable operating profit for 2026 will amount to €690–730 million, while our previous estimate was €670–730 million.

Insurance revenue Insurance revenue amounted to DKK 10,591m (DKK 10,175m), corresponding to a growth of 2.3% (3.4%) in local currencies.
This was driven by the Private segment growing 3.7% (3.8%) measured in local currencies with organic growth in selected segments, for instance in Private Norway.
Revenue growth was 4.1% measured in DKK, or 2.3% in local currencies, with the highest growth in Norway.

Q1-Q3 2026 results Insurance revenue growth of 3.0% (3.7%) measured in local currencies was mainly driven by portfolio growth in selected segments and profitability initiatives to mitigate inflation, particularly in Private Norway.

report.title: Q1 Trading Statement 2026/27:  Bang & Olufsen generated revenue growth of 2.2% in local currencies

results.text: Reported revenue increased by 2.5% (-5.0%) year- on-year, or 2.2% in local currencies (-4.0%), to DKK 530m (DKK 517m).
EBITDA before special items was DKK 42m (DKK 34m), with an EBITDA margin before special items of 8.0% (6.5%).
Revenue was DKK 226m compared to DKK 234m in Q1 last year, representing a decline of 3.4% or 3.6% in local currencies.
Revenue was DKK 62m, unchanged from Q1 last year, representing a decline of 0.4% or 1.4% in local currencies.
Revenue was DKK 177m compared to DKK 159m in Q1 last year, representing an increase of 11.7% or 11.5% in local currencies.
Revenue from China increased by 10.3% year-on-year, equivalent to growth of 2.9% in local currencies and accounting for approximately 50% of total revenue in APAC.

outlook.text: Page — 1 Trading statement Q1 2026/27 June 2026-August 2026 Page — 2 Management’s review Q1 2026/27 In Q1 2026/27, Bang & Olufsen generated revenue growth of 2.2% in local currencies, in line with expectations.
